title: Check whether the label conforms to the fixed encoding format
goal: uses character class, degree and boundary to build the pattern, and then use test to return a Boolean value.
summary: woodshop label consists of two uppercase English letters, a hyphen and three decimal digits.
tasks: completes validLabel(text), which returns true only if the complete string conforms to the rules.
numbers can contain leading zeros. Spaces, lowercase letters, or extra characters invalidate the format.

example.note: [A-Z] matches an uppercase letter, {2} requires the previous part to appear twice. ^ and $ constrain the beginning and end respectively.

hint: uses [A-Z]{2} and [0-9]{3}, with a hyphen in between. Remember that the pattern needs to match the entire string.
